programme.title: Turystyczna jazda
programme.desc: Ekipa Turystycznej Jazdy ponownie wypływa na szerokie wody. W trakcie naszej morskiej podróży wraz z autorami programu odwiedzimy kilka miast portowych Morza Śródziemnego. Zajrzymy na plaże Ibizy, zwiedzimy Rzym na skuterze i będziemy wędrować z kamerą pośród ulicznych straganów w Palermo.

programme.title: Podróże z historią
programme.desc: Radosław Kotarski odkrywa burzliwą historię kresowych miast. Przy okazji odnajduje miejsca najbliższe sercom polskich królów i magnatów oraz odwiedza najlepszą szkołę w historii Rzeczpospolitej.

programme.title: Awantura o Basię
programme.desc: Minęło 10 lat, Basia wyrosła na śliczną i szaloną pannicę (teraz w tej roli Paulina Tworzyańska). Jej ulubiony wujcio staje się idolem szkolnych przyjaciółek. Na ich prośbę Basia wykrada z domu drobiazgi należące do sławnego pisarza.

programme.title: Awantura o Basię
programme.desc: O względy Basi rywalizują dwaj młodzieńcy. Dziewczyna nie wie, którego wybrać, więc wystawia ich na próbę. Zazdrosna koleżanka Wanda odbija jej jednego z chłopców.

programme.title: Jak to się mówi, czyli Kasia u Bralczyka
Na dobre i na złe
programme.desc: Doktor Jakubek na dyżurze nagle zaczyna tak źle się czuć, że przerywa pracę przekonany, że ma zawał. Oliwa zostaje sama na placu boju i musi przez to samodzielnie wykonać ryzykowną operację u kobiety z poważnym urazem wątroby.

programme.title: Okrasa łamie przepisy
programme.desc: W kolejnej wyprawie kulinarnej Karol Okrasa wyrusza w podwarszawskie lasy, położone w dolinie rzeki Świder. Jesienne lasy co roku przyciągają Polaków tłumnie wyruszających po jeden z największych skarbów rodzimej kuchni, czyli grzyby.

programme.title: Europa da się lubić - nowe pokolenie
Czterdziestolatek
programme.desc: Inżynier Karwowski poznaje młodą, seksowną pielęgniarkę. Sfrustrowany do niedawna czterdziestolatek budzi się do życia. Żona, przyjaciele i koledzy w pracy obserwują poważne zmiany w jego zachowaniu. Nowe wcielenie Stefana wywołuje - do pewnego stopnia uzasadniony - niepokój otoczenia. Madzia wysłuchuje pouczeń Kobiety Pracującej, jak przeczekać krytyczną sytuację.

programme.title: 63. KFPP w Opolu
programme.desc: W tym roku Festiwal w Opolu zwieńczył koncert poświęcony twórczości dwóch wybitnych artystek - Magdy Umer i Agnieszki Osieckiej. Magda Umer była wybitną wykonawczynią poezji śpiewanej, dziennikarką, reżyserką, scenarzystką i aktorką.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Motocyklista ginie na bocznej drodze. Przywiązana między drzewami linka odcina mu głowę. Na komisariacie Jacek i Henryk przesłuchują Adę Kowalczyk. Pretekstem jest zamknięcie sprawy zabójstwa jej męża.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Nocą dwaj mężczyźni biją się na skraju drogi. Jeden z nich zostaje raniony nożem w brzuch. Gdy udaje mu się dotrzeć do szosy, zostaje potrącony przez samochód, ale kierowca nie udziela mu pomocy. Henryk idzie się ostrzyc do Ady Kowalczyk.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Andy Hardy Meets Debutante

Andy immediately forgets about Polly Benedict (Ann Rutherford), his girlfriend back home, and falls head over heels for Daphne. But as he starts to rub elbows with trendy Manhattanites, he begins to long for Polly -- and he soon realizes that the big city lacks the charms of his small hometown.

programme.title: Andy Hardy's Private Secretary

However, all Andy can think about is participating in school clubs. When his workload simply gets too heavy, he has the bright idea to enlist the attractive Kathryn (Kathryn Grayson) to be his receptionist, which makes his girlfriend, Polly (Ann Rutherford), jealous. Unfortunately, Andy will need both Kathryn and Polly to help him if he is to pass his dreaded English test.

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero

But when he's given a medical discharge after only a month, he takes a job at a San Diego shipyard and writes letters to his mother about his fictitious wartime exploits. When he returns home, he discovers that his innocent lies have spread further than he expected.

programme.title: The Great McGinty

As a young man, McGinty joins a crooked political boss and rises from extortionist to alderman. Urged by the boss to marry his secretary to give respectability to his run for mayor, McGinty agrees -- only to fall in love with his wife and decide to do an honest thing for once in his life.

programme.title: Christmas in July

To everyone's surprise, the coffee company owner, Dr. Maxford (Raymond Walburn), also falls for the prank and awards the prize check to Jimmy. Eventually the ruse is discovered, jeopardizing Jimmy and Betty's newfound happiness.

programme.title: The Palm Beach Story

When Tom follows Gerry, they cross paths with the quirky millionaire John D. Hackensacker III (Rudy Vallee) and his chatty, husband-seeking sister, Princess Centimillia (Mary Astor).

programme.title: The Lady Eve

With love and payback on her mind, she re-introduces herself to Charles, this time as an aristocrat named Lady Eve Sidwich.

programme.title: Sullivan's Travels

programme.title: His & Her Christmas
programme.desc: Tom Lane is the star columnist for the media conglomerate owned San Francisco Sun newspaper. The company is thinking about increasing Tom's exposure by producing a new television show around him. Liz Madison is the advice columnist for the little read community newspaper, the Marin County Voice, which is a throwback to gentler times. Besides their journalistic occupations, one other similar aspect between Tom and Liz is that they are both currently single, with their friends and family doing whatever they can to find that special someone for their personal life. On November 2, the staff at the Voice learn that the Sun ownership has bought their newspaper, with the probable goal of folding it into the operations of the Sun. If this move does happen, the staff at the Voice will lose their jobs. To fight back, Liz decides to change her column to an editorial espousing the meaning of Christmas and the newspaper to the community.

The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.desc: When the Shane Gang arrive at a cavern overrun by thieves terrorizing the good townfolk, they decide to use Pronto as bait, hoping the thieves will eliminate each other as each strives to be the first to capture the valuable molenoid-the only one the Eastern Caverns have ever seen. However, their plan goes awry when Underlord Holt arrives and commands the thieves to work together to bring him Pronto-dead or alive!

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: When the Shane Gang travel to the Auroris Mine, they discover a legendary monster carved out of stone attacking the mines-the Pyritor. programme.title: Slugterra

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: A winter-time holiday has arisen in the Eastern Caverns around the mysterious "Giver," who makes an annual visit to deliver slugs to the people of the East. But when a group of thieves make off with the Giver's precious cargo of slugs, our heroes must ride to the rescue-and discover the secret of who the Giver really is.

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.sub-title: The Fall of the Eastern Champion
programme.desc: Junjie recounts the ancient history of the Eastern Caverns and his ancestors, and the events that led to his downfall and transformation from the Eastern Champion to the Dark Slinger.

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: When Pronto accidentally uses the Emperor's sword blaster, he can suddenly do no wrong. Lady Dai-Fu manipulates Underlord Holt into trapping the Shane Gang with a new superweapon: the Iron Warrior!

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: The Emperor has returned! After the Shane Gang failed to defeat the Iron Warrior, the Emperor sets to work creating even more Unstoppable Warriors to reclaim the Eastern Caverns. The Shane Gang search for a way to defeat the new creations, but when the Emperor places a bounty on Junjie's head, they also have to deal with the Dai-Fu and hordes of the Emperor's Underlords.

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.sub-title: The Return of the Eastern Champion
programme.desc: Junjie, Eli and the Gang rally their friends and even some old enemies-to help them take down the Emperor.

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: The Shane Gang return home to the 99 caverns to find Gateway Cavern overrun with slugs-in Eli's absence, the Shadow Clan have governed by putting the slugs before the people, and the result is chaos! It's up to Eli to restore the balance, but the Shadow Clan aren't as friendly as they once were...and that's saying something. Help comes from an unexpected source-Tad and his slug Pieper, who just arrived from the Surface!

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: The Shane Gang take Tad under their wing, training him to blast like a pro with Eli's old blaster and teaching him to live by the slugslinger's code. Tad takes to it like a natural, and as Kord says, it looks like they have another "slugslinging savant from the Surface" on their hands. But their training will be put to the test when Tad accompanies them to a showdown with the Scrap Force...and the Shadow Clan!

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: Tad is still missing after the slug-out with the Shadow Clan, but the Gang have to set off without him when reports start coming in of slugs disappearing all across the 99 caverns. As they pursue the trail of missing slugs, the mystery grows darker when it leads them straight to Dr. Blakk's old stronghold!

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: Tad's hypnotic slug Pieper has gone megamorph, his gang of supporters all have Gattler blasters, and Tad's control over his army of ghouls is stronger than Dr. Blakk's ever was. programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: My First Signs: See and Sign With Baby
programme.desc: As babies grow, their eye-hand coordination begins to improve as their ability to interact with their surroundings blossoms. It is the perfect time for My First Signs, A playful introduction to 20 common words and phrases from baby's world -- including ''mommy'', ''daddy'' and ''I love you'' -- both Spoken and in Sign Language.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Early on in babies' development, they begin to recognize primary colors such as blue, red, and yellow. And all the while, they're also processing an infinite variety of new sights and sounds. Think of the joy you'll experience as you introduce your little one to beautiful music and imagery with Baby Beethoven Symphony of Fun.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Cal, Neptune, Opus, Dean, Tinker and others learn about the flora and fauna of the ocean through STEAM-based principles and real-life footage.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: As little ones grow, their innate sense of wonder grows too, creating an occasion for celebration with each new discovery. Baby Galileo Discovering the Sky introduces them to that remarkable canopy above us: the sun and moon, fluffy clouds, shimmering stars, colorful planets and whirling galaxies.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Isn't the world exciting?! Learn about things found in nature like flowers, grass, trees, and leaves with real-life footage and narration. Sing-along to popular nursery rhymes and learn about common bedtime themes. Teach baby how to say words like eat, milk, and all done verbally and through sign language. Discover words and activities about playtime and friendship.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Join our playful puppet host, Bard the Dragon, on a fun-filled adventure using everyday words such as flower, cat, and moon, and beautiful scenery from nature. World Of Words lets you and your little one share the excitement of discovering new words together!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Meet fascinating creatures from across the globe and learn to run, hop, and crawl like your favorite animal friends. Dance and sing along to discover animal names and the native habitats of the world's most unique creatures. See real-life images of lions and zebras on the African savannah, then learn animal names through repetition and narration, or simply watch your favorite animals play!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring
programme.desc: As little ones become increasingly mobile, their fascination with all things that move intensifies too. On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring exposes babies to the different ways people travel -- on land, by sea, and in the air -- while it presents them with captivating real-world images, funny puppet shows, and beautiful classical music by Beethoven, Haydn, Mozart and Rossini.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Discover the exciting world of shapes and colors! Learn about the primary colors red, yellow, and blue with real-life imagery of animals and objects. Explore colors like purple, orange, and green and see artwork by Van Gogh! Discover the circles, squares, and triangles that surround us in everyday life, and introduce baby to the world of visual arts as children and artists create their own work!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby's First Moves: Get Up and Go
programme.desc: Within the first year of babies' lives, their physical development begins to kick into high gear as they explore ways to physically interact with the world around them. BABY'S FIRST MOVES is a joyful celebration of their movement milestones -- including first steps, clapping, jumping, dancing and more.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Within a baby's first year of life, new experiences can transform what might otherwise seem to be ordinary events into exciting opportunities for imaginative play. Baby Neptune exposes little ones to the wonders of water in their world -- whether they're stomping in the rain, splashing in the bathtub, playing "catch me if you can" with the tide on the beach, or "meeting" the fascinating creatures that live in rivers, lakes and oceans.

programme.title: The Who
programme.sub-title: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan's expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming ‘Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.title: Muse
programme.sub-title: Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Muse.

programme.title: Motörhead
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days. Featuring : Motörhead

programme.title: Various Artists
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts

programme.title: Daryl Hall & John Oates
programme.sub-title: Hall & Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney's Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater' began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up. Daryl Hall and John Oates wisely reunited a few years ago after a string of solo projects, and although Oates no longer sports his signature ‘tache, they put on the kind of show that makes it hard to believe they even considered going their separate ways. Earworms like ‘I Can't Go For That', ‘Out Of Touch' and ‘Kiss On My List' were surefire reminders that these guys are absolute hit machines, and their catchy synth-soul classics probably deserve to permeate the airwaves as much today as they did decades ago. These Philly crooners still have it in bucket-loads, so this show should have everyone from diehard Daryl Hall and John Oates fans to kids of the 80's groovin' along in no time.

programme.title: Archie Shepp All Star
programme.sub-title: Archie Shepp All Star - Tribute to John Coltrane
programme.desc: In 1960, Archie Shepp attended a concert of John Coltrane at the Five Spot, legendary club of the Lower East Side. Fascinated, he quickly decided to devote himself to the tenor saxophone. Five years later, Shepp - already a staple of free jazz - finally recorded alongside his idol. The result, published in 1966, is called Ascension and still remains today a symbol of free improvisation. At the edge of the fiftieth anniversary of Coltrane's death, gone at forty, the most Parisian of the New York avant-garde celebrates the legacy of the great composer of A Love Supreme with a dazzling French-American all-star who is reminiscent in some respects of the heretic Ascension orchestra. When a giant pays tribute to a god of jazz...

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bootsy Collins
programme.sub-title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World'. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon, George Gruntz, Guy Pedersen & Daniel Humair
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 & '64 features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history, Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style in this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

Гладиатори S1 E1 Сухият сезон затяга хватката си върху малък водоем в голямата савана на Южна Африка; тук група гладиатори - големи и малки - са събрани в опасна близост.

Гладиатори S1 E2 Австралия е земя, отделена от другите от времето на динозаврите; изолирана в продължение на милиони години, еволюцията е превърнала нейните животни в най-впечатляващите гладиатори на планетата.
Гладиатори S1 E4 В далечния север на Америка има области с реки, блата и крайбрежия. Животните тук са най-добрите бойци, тъй като те са елитът на природата и калени в битки воини.

Хищници Срещата на хищник с плячка е драматично събитие в природата: за единия е храна, за другия - въпрос на живот и смърт. Показваме какви стратегии използват най-големите хищници, за да уловят плячката си.

Хищници Срещата на хищник с плячка е драматично събитие в природата: за единия е храна, за другия - въпрос на живот и смърт. Показваме какви стратегии използват най-големите хищници, за да уловят плячката си.

Речни Чудовища S3 E6 Джереми пътува до Япония, за да се опита да разкрие истината зад две от техните най-необикновени легенди за речни чудовища. Той е на път да открие чудовище, несравнимо с нищо, което е виждал досега.

Ягуарски хроники S1 E5 Екипът се запознава с новооткритата женска Ароейра и вижда малкото на Аврора - Аполо. Междувременно Бадало е навлязъл по-дълбоко в наводнената гора и това застрашава изследванията на Лизи.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E1 Стив Бакшал изследва река Балием на остров Нова Гвинея; той започва пътешествието си от езерото Хабема и се натъква на едни от най-екстремните бързеи, съществуващи на планетата.

Сан Андреас: надпревара с времето Разломът Сан Андреас е пресечна точка на две тектонични плочи, простиращи се през Сан Франциско и Лос Анджелис. Той е дълъг 1300 км и в момента е най-проучваният феномен в света.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E6 Студент описва урагана Мария от 2017 г., който опустошава Пуерто Рико. Градушка унищожава дом на семейство в Далас. Турист в дивата природа се опитва да спаси живота си при внезапно наводнение.

programme.title: UA 亞洲聯合財務呈獻: 悠長假期 重新出發 第10集
WeWa卡玩轉地球呈獻: 收夜的美食家 第5集
programme.desc: 「宵夜係自願，收夜係被迫」 疫情後，相信全港打工仔都面對同一問題，一但OT收夜，在市面還有甚麼餐廳可以光顧？ 「宵夜」係你食飽之後的飯後甜品，「收夜」係捱完OT之後但咩都未食的人間悲劇。 為回應市民訴求，Jacky, Arvin 化身「收夜的美食家」，走訪香港各區晚上9點後依然熱鬧營業的各式餐廳，讓各位觀眾知道即使要OT或收夜，除左連鎖店的漢堡薯條，仲可以選擇中式、日式、美式、韓式，港式飲茶鑊氣小炒通通都有！ Jacky Fan及Arvin曾傲棐除了會介紹這些「收夜」餐廳的美食之外，也會訪問這些小店老闆了解他們的故事之餘，亦有嘉賓好友作為飯腳！ 除「收夜」餐廳美食介紹之外，也會有小環節介紹主持們的神秘食法，讓大家可以快速方便吃到一個有溫度兼好味道的Late Dinner！

programme.desc: 香港靈異學會會長Jacqueline對靈學非常有研究，當面對近年親友相繼離世，她曾收到逝者托夢向她交代身後事安排，亦試過打破自己一貫做法，以自己熟悉的探靈儀器與剛去世不久的朋友溝通，了解他未了的心事。

programme.desc: 每位男生心目中總有位像那些年女主角的「鄰家女孩」，而今集女神直頭是名符其實的鄰家女神！節目組真的深知Marco心，這位女嘉賓其實Marco曾經衝口而出提過的，現在果真如願以償！不論身型還是外表，總有種想保護她的衝動！但這位女神的喜好卻讓Marco及神隊友Kyle都百思不得其解的，反差極高！二人都分不清什麼是玩笑，什麼是真話！Marco這次只好摸著石頭過河，放手一搏！

programme.desc: Gen Z，世界對呢個新世代有好多標籤，究竟幾多真幾多假？就交俾Gen X代表強尼、Gen Y代表阿娟同Gen Z代表Boris同大家上一堂《GenZ 觀察學》，拉近幾代嘅距離！每個禮拜主持們都會認識來自各種範疇嘅GenZ們，今集係來自創業組同追夢組嘅四位GenZ！強尼除咗邀請註冊組織心理學家Mills Wong同四位做心理測試，仲帶佢哋去老蘭進行成人禮！

programme.title: MOSHI MOSHI 富士山 第9集

programme.title: 消失的味道 第1集
programme.desc: 在流行用QR Code落單的今天，位於深水埗的茶樓「中央飯店」仍然有點心車，還售賣大包、燒腩卷、鵪鶉蛋燒賣這些懷舊點心；今年94歲的明叔，一生人只專注做一件事，就是手製竹蒸籠，可是他那位於藍地的廠房正面臨收地，香港唯一的手製蒸籠廠也要消失了嗎？

programme.title: COLLAR 以為去度假 第5集
programme.desc: 運動健將Candy加上活力十足的Ivy聯手帶隊！她們第一站就安排大型水上探險樂園之旅，放低偶像包袱喪玩，仲手拖手浮潛，真正濕濕碎不要顧慮！而今次旅途遇上突發事件，作風各異的兩位導遊又會怎樣安撫團友呢？

programme.title: 回憶守護隊 第10集
programme.desc: 日本不少商店街面對人口老化，後繼無人的窘境，部分商店街最後更被荒廢。大阪有酒店把酒店設施和商店街一體化，務求協助活化商店街的同時，為遊客帶來新的體驗，Sica將會帶大家感受這條商店街的人情味。

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥 第31集

programme.title: 湯姆貓英雄小隊：超能爆發 第7集
名偵探光之美少女！ 第35集
職人小學徒 第20集 -沙畫藝術家
programme.desc: 沙畫，是指縫間的沙在光影中的舞蹈，其美麗稍瞬即逝，反而更令人著迷。沙畫藝術家胡藹的(Miss 的)，擅長用沙畫娓娓道出動人的故事，今集她就自帶小學徒，兩個人把著手讓主持體驗一下沙畫流動的詩意。

programme.title: 大鳴大放 第1031集
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界。

programme.title: 與父母「同行」 第6集
programme.desc: 有⼀群年輕人，童年的超級英雄不是 Marvel，而是父母的背影。他們選擇走上父母的路，不是因為這條路好行，而是因為這條路「好型」。本節目講述 10 個「粉絲追星」的故事： 這些子女因為崇拜父母而決定長大後也要穿上同⼀套制服，考取同⼀個牌照；亦有人嘗試父母道路後才發現有更適合自己發展的方向、崗位，在這個非家族生意的殘酷職場中，憑實力成為偶像的「同行」，發展出自己的人生。

programme.title: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: 處於浮華城市之中，有些人渴望的僅僅是不知何時才會出現的一線光。獨力經營清潔公司的窄哥（張繼聰飾），面對疫情來襲，百業蕭條，遇上失業的年輕單親媽媽Candy（袁澧林飾）前來求職。看似不務正業的 Candy竟能化解窄哥工作上的困難，正當二人以為生活漸入佳境，疫情變成生活一部份時，清潔公司遭人投訴，同時窄哥家中又遭逢巨變。儘管人如微塵，也能在窄路遇上稍作依偎......

programme.title: 調教你男友 第8集
programme.desc: 男人都要學懂保護女人，然而面對三屆世界冠軍，男友們可能先要學懂如何保護自己。挑戰泰拳訓練，哪一位可以成為拳王導師心中的最佳Fighter及最佳男友? 法國人等同浪漫，那男友們在法國導師身上，又是否可以感染到一些浪漫氣質而令自己文武雙全? 可惜，在他們心中，法式濕吻才是最希望學懂一課。

programme.title: 拆你個夢 第13集
programme.desc: Phoebus 夢中變囚犯，大隻佬協助逃獄；拆夢反映他偶像包袱依然沉重，並隱藏 Hehe 疑惑，激起一場「直攣」辯論比賽。

programme.title: 運動員背後 第15集
programme.desc: 數據分析技術於香港球圈近年開始「矚目」，不過至今仍未算被廣泛使用到。超聯球隊理文可謂數據分析「龍頭」，而他們的技術分析教練郭駿林「阿林」就一直利用數據分析技術協助球隊更上一層樓。阿林甫畢業便加入球圈擔任行政工作，職業生涯中阿林亦曾感到迷惘，短暫退出球壇，因緣際會下，「破格」成為超聯球隊理文教練團之一。除了擔當主隊技術分析教練外，亦是理文青年軍的教練，阿林希望以身作則，教踢波；同時教一班「明日之星」一個好球員的應有品格……

programme.title: 文藝誌 第86集
programme.desc: 速寫團體走到第十年，不知道他們筆下的城市有何變遷？今集繼續聽聽他們的分享。

programme.title: 平行教室 第22集
programme.desc: 活躍於跨界合作的音樂創作者- 崔展鴻，作品涵蓋劇場、電影及獨立音樂。他擅長融合不同樂器和聲響，創造富有畫面感音樂語言，不斷探索聲音藝術邊界。

programme.title: 環保發現號 第84集
programme.desc: 環保好難搞？你實在太悲觀啦！我們看到的處處都是環保新機遇！《環保發現號》將會帶大家走一趟環保之旅，接觸不同的環保人士，從個人出發，由理念開始，在他們身上取經，如何透過行動實踐環保！既然香港有接近700萬人口，節目就探索出700萬種環保生活！令你重新發現「環保」兩個字，其實唔難！

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Vellezerit qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70. Familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Historia e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer, ne boset e droges. Bazuar ne librin ”El cartel de los sapos” te Andres Lopez.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik më i ndjekur dhe më i preferuar në ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikës shqiptare që prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, dëshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet më të fundit dhe më të rëndësishme...

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara

programme.desc: Doan, një kirurg i suksesshëm që ka shpëtuar shumë jetë, por nuk ka mundur të shpëtojë të tijën. Ai u largua nga familja, nga dhimbja, nga kujtimet. Por disa plagë nuk shërohen kurrë. Dhe në hije një armik që pret momentin e tij, Behram, një emër që sjell frikë dhe hakmarrje.

programme.title: Pro Business
programme.desc: Nga idete qe marrin jete, tek kompanite qe ndertojne ekonomi, te njerezit qe po lene gjurme, te projektet qe po transformojne te ardhmen. programme.title: S1E4 - Në mbrojtje të Xhejkobit
programme.desc: Chris Evans. Bazuar në romain best seller të ”New York Times”. Kur i biri adoleshent akuzohet për një krim që tronditi gjithë qytezën, prokurori Andi Barber detyrohet të zgjedhë mes betimit për të mbështetur drejtësinë dhe dashurisë së pakushtëzuar të një babai.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Jetë të kundërta
programme.desc: Një vëmendje e veçantë do t’u kushtohet njerëzve që i japin jetë turizmit dimëror: sipërmarrësve lokalë, bujtinave familjare, artizanëve, guidave turistike dhe komuniteteve që ruajnë traditat dhe identitetin shqiptar.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Shqipëria Live
programme.desc: Programi ku perfshihen te gjitha tematikat kryesore te momentit. Te ftuar te ndryshem, intervista ekskluzive, lidhje direkte dhe debat ne studio. Nje mbulim 360 grade i ngjarjeve ne kohe reale, gjithcka qe ndodh ne vendin tone. Nje nga shtyllat kryesore te programit eshte larmishmeria e perfshirjes te figurave te ndryshme qofte ne studio por edhe nga terreni. Nje program i përditshëm informativ dhe i aktualitetit, i cili sjell në qendër të vëmendjes ngjarjet më të rëndësishme të ditës.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Wake Up
programme.desc: Emisioni sjell një kombinim të lajmeve më të rëndësishme të ditës, analizave të aktualitetit, parashikimit të motit, informacioneve praktike, intervistave me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, rubrikave të argëtimit dhe muzikës. Me një atmosferë dinamike dhe pozitive, synon t’i informojë dhe argëtojë teleshikuesit, duke u ofruar energjinë e duhur për nisjen e ditës.

programme.title: Në shtëpinë tonë
programme.desc: Në Shtëpinë Tonë” është emisioni i paradites në Top Channel, një hapësirë e ngrohtë ku bashkohen historia, emocionet, informacioni dhe argëtimi. Me personazhe të njohur e të zakonshëm, rrëfime që frymëzojnë, tema që prekin jetën familjare dhe këshilla praktike për përditshmërinë, programi bëhet pjesë e shtëpisë së çdo teleshikuesi. Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.title: Live me Luizin
programme.desc: Eshtë një spektakël argëtues që ndërthur intervistën, muzikën live, humorin dhe lojërat në një mbrëmje plot ritëm dhe surpriza.\r\nNë çdo episod, Luiz Ejlli mirëpret personazhe të njohura, duke i sjellë përpara publikut përmes bisedave të sinqerta, historive të pathëna dhe pyetjeve të papritura. Intervistat ndërthuren me sfida argëtuese, performanca muzikore live dhe momente spontane, ku të ftuarit dalin përtej imazhit të tyre publik.

programme.title: 7 xhuxhat
programme.desc: Ata janë 7 xhuxhat më të famshë në botë. Ata jetojnë në Xhollivud, aty ku ka një mbretëreshë gazmore por edhe armiqtë janë gjithandej. Ndiqni aventurat e heronjve tuaj më të rinj.

programme.title: Parajsa e zonjave
programme.desc: 3 vjet pas vdekjes se Pietro Morit, Vitorio Konti ben nje investim gjigant ne ”Parajsen e zonjave” fale nje huaje qe merr nga Umberto Guarnieri qe do ta fuse ne telashe me kohe. Po Vitorio ka probleme sentimentale, pasi familja e Martes eshte kunder.

programme.title: S0E2 - Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Familja Krouli e shërbëtorët e tyre ne Downton Abbey ne rrezik per te ardhmen, në ankth për ardhjen e Methju Kroulit, trashëgimtarit të supozuar. Karsoni poshtërohet nga përballja me të kaluarën e tij.

programme.title: S2E0 - Mirë se vini në Shqipëri
programme.desc: Në fokus te programit do të jenë turizmi dimëror malor, agroturizmi, gastronomia tradicionale, trashëgimia kulturore, festat e fundvitit dhe eksperiencat dimërore, duke promovuar Shqipërinë si një destinacion tërheqës për turistët vendas dhe të huaj gjatë gjithë vitit.Një vëmendje e veçantë do t’u kushtohet njerëzve që i japin jetë turizmit dimëror: sipërmarrësve lokalë, bujtinave familjare, artizanëve, guidave turistike dhe komuniteteve që ruajnë traditat dhe identitetin shqiptar.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Të Guximshmit
programme.desc: Ka në qendër udhëtimet dhe aventurat nëpër Shqipëri. Qëllimi i emisionit është ta zbulojë vendin (Shqipërinë, Kosovën, Malin e Zi dhe Maqedoninë e Veriut) përtej destinacioneve të zakonshme, duke sjellë në ekran përvoja, histori dhe vende që meritojnë të njihen më shumë. Çdo episod sjell një grup personazhesh të njohur nga fusha të ndryshme, të cilët nisen drejt një destinacioni të ri dhe përfshihen në aventura jashtë përditshmërisë së tyre.

programme.title: Artkand
programme.desc: Eshtë një program televiziv I cili sjell ne vemendje boten e artit por vjen edhe në formën e një ankandi veprash arti. Piktura, skulptura, antikuarë e cdo vepër arti e një cilësie të vecantë mund të bëhët pjesë e programit. Përmes bashkëpunimit me koleksionitë, artistë dhe menaxherë arti vijne ne program ekspozitat dhe veprat me te mira te artisteve shqiptare dhe koleksionisteve te ndryshem.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Hipokrati
programme.desc: ”Hipokrati”, programi që do të na bashkojë në më te rëndësishmen e të gjithëve ne, shëndetin. Debate, informacion për çdo problematikë shëndetësore, mjekë që do të përgjigjen e flasin ne gjuhën tuaj, për të informuar dhe ndikuar mirëqenjen tuaj. Histori suksesi të mjekëve tanë më të mirë, anembane Shqipërisë. Këshilla, te rejat më të fundit të shkencës ne mjekësi, mite e të vërteta.

programme.title: S2E0 - Urban Gen
programme.desc: Eshtë një projekt i Fondacionit Dritan Hoxha, në bashkëpunim me Top Channel, që vendos të rinjtë në qendër të vëmendjes, duke u dhënë zë ideve, përvojave dhe shqetësimeve të tyre. Synimi i programit është të frymëzojë dhe fuqizojë brezin e ri, të promovojë talentin, kreativitetin dhe zhvillimin personal e profesional, si dhe të nxisë dialogun mbi çështjet sociale, kulturore qe përfshijnë brezin e ri.

programme.title: S’e Luan Topi

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Cristina kehrt ins Seattle Grace zurück. Doch Dr. Hunt zeigt ihr die kalte Schulter. Ist ihre Trennung endgültig? Dr. Bailey lässt sich indes so einiges einfallen, um Arizona aus ihrer Apathie zu holen. Callie (Sara Ramirez) schöpft schließlich neue Hoffnung, Dereks (Patrick Dempsey) Hand zu retten.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Chirurgin Arizona (Jessica Capshaw) hat ihren ersten Arbeitstag nach der Beinamputation. Kollege Alex (Justin Chambers), der sie auf Stand bringt, trifft Vorkehrungen, damit beim Neustart nichts schiefgeht. Callie bittet Jackson, ihr bei Dereks Hand-OP zu helfen. Doch der muss erst eine Schreckensnachricht verdauen.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Auftakt des zweiteiligen Staffelfinales: Zwischen Felicia (Harriet S. Harris) und Paul (Mark Moses) spitzt sich die Lage zu. Susan findet sich hinter Gittern wieder. Tom und Lynette versuchen, ihre Ehe zu retten. Und Gaby sieht sich von einem geheimnisvollen Mann verfolgt.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Seit Carlos im Finale der letzten Staffel Gabys Stiefvater tötete, und die Ladys (Eva Longoria, Marcia Cross, Felicity Huffman, Teri Hatcher) die Tat vertuschten, liegen die Nerven blank. Hält ihre Freundschaft das Geschehene aus? \n\nAuftakt der 8. und letzten Staffel. Neu dabei: Charles Mesure („V – Die Besucher“) als neuer Nachbar und Hingucker.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Kann eine Stripperin wieder Schwung ins Liebesleben mit Carlos bringen? Gabrielle setzt zumindest auf diesen Versuch. Susan setzt hingegen alles daran, ihre Schuldgefühle abzuarbeiten. Die Komplizenschaft bei der Ermordung von Alejandro kann sie nicht zugeben, aber durch kleine Straftaten, für die sich bestraft werden will, hofft sie, letztlich auch Schuld zu tilgen.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Was läuft da? Mikes (James Denton) Misstrauen wird geweckt, als er sieht, wie viel Zeit seine Frau Susan neuerdings mit Carlos verbringt. Die beiden sehen sich schließlich gezwungen, Mike die Wahrheit zu erzählen. Lynette bekommt Besuch von ihrer Schwester Lydia.
